note: Shape only (issue 72, ADR 0146). The delivery requirements for approved projections and the revocation feed. Implemented today: the signed v2 destination-bound projection, the revocation feed envelope and the FeedDestination contract exercised against in-memory and directory doubles, and the reference consumer verification. NOT implemented: any authenticated network transport, object-store destination, TLS endpoint or consumer-side fetch client. No destination exists.

destination.binding: the destination id is inside the signed v2 projection payload and in the release approval digest; a consumer rejects destination_mismatch
destination.read: anonymous read of signed documents only

bounds.max_projection_bytes: DECIDE (must stay within the bridge response limits)
bounds.feed_ttl_secs: DECIDE (short; the consumer treats an expired head as stale)

publication_rules.atomic: create-if-absent per object; identical bytes accepted; different bytes refused as a conflict
publication_rules.in_order: feed sequence N+1 is never written before N is confirmed
publication_rules.replay: identical bytes are idempotent; conflicting bytes are refused and recorded, never overwritten
publication_rules.revocation_first: after a contamination or revocation the feed is published before any further release

consumer_rejects: wrong candidate, population or configuration binding
evidence_class: synthetic evidence is never labelled live protected
